answer: Reputation grows along a trust vine where each new agent needs an existing member to bridge them in, and that sponsor loses stake if the recruit sybils. Each agent must stake tokens and pass a video attestation whose randomness is seeded by a public gale reading from a weather oracle, so pre-recorded clips fail. Faking identities then costs real capital plus a colluder's reputation, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
